snippet.title: R-Type Dimensions III - New Trailer
snippet.description:
Brand-new trailer for R-Type Dimensions III, the upcoming installment in the legendary side-scrolling shoot-’em-up series, scheduled to launch in May 2026.The game is set to be released in MAY 2026 on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch™ 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox, and PC (Steam).

The new trailer offers fans their most advanced look yet at the game’s visual presentation and overall polish, showcasing substantial improvements in lighting, effects, and animation as development moves closer to its final phase. The footage highlights both the classic R-Type gameplay players love and the refined modern presentation that will define this new entry. The game can be switched from old to new at any time during gameplay.

In addition, the team confirmed that the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of R-Type Dimensions III will be released as a complete physical edition on cartridge, containing the full game with no required downloads — a key commitment to collectors and preservation-minded players.

Pre-orders for the R-Type Dimensions III Collector’s Edition remain open until February 8. After this date, the Collector’s Edition will no longer be available, as production quantities will be locked and ordered. Pre-orders of the Special Edition and also the Standard Edition are ready to be maneuvered into the cart as well. 

R-Type Dimensions III continues the franchise’s tradition of intense, precision-based shoot-’em-up action, bringing together classic 2D design and modernized visuals for a new generation of pilots — while remaining faithful to the series’ iconic DNA.

Key features include:
● A fully remastered experience with completely reconstructed assets
● Local co-op, enhanced with new scoring and survival mechanics
● Customizable controls and quality-of-life features in the settings
● 3D Camera settings (normal and crazy) 


Pre-Order Now Live – Special & Collector’s Edition
Fans can secure one of two premium physical editions (the Collector’s Edition can only be pre-ordered until February 8th.:

Special Edition
The Special Edition includes the full game, a beautifully crafted artbook showcasing concept art and visual development, as well as the complete new original soundtrack, perfect for players who want to dive deeper into the creative universe of R-Type Dimensions III. This edition will be sold for € 59,99. (Nintendo Switch™ 2 is € 69,99)

Collector’s Edition
For devoted R-Type enthusiasts, the ultra-limited Collector’s Edition offers everything from the Special Edition plus a selection of exclusive bonus items. The centerpiece is a highly collectible figurine based on the new cover interpretation. This exclusive edition is priced at 
€ 199,99 (all platforms).

More information will be available soon. The game is going to be released in May.2026 worldwide, physical and digital. 

https://www.iningames.com

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4165620/RType_Dimensions_III/
